Hooks and hashtags — four-day week, 2026-11-10
## Hooks
1. "61 companies tried a four-day week for six months; 56 kept it." [1]
2. "We did not give people Friday off. We took Friday's work away." [2]
## Hashtags
- LinkedIn: #fourdayweek #futureofwork
- X: #4dayweek
## Sources
1. example.org/pilot — "56 of 61 companies will continue"; "revenue flat".
2. blog.example/fifth-day — "14 standing meetings cut to 5."

- What the five saw that the rest missed

## Slides
2. Revenue was flat for all 61 — Output was never the problem. [1]
3. 14 meetings became 5 — The teams that stayed cut them. The five never did. [2]
4. A meeting cull with a day off — Skip the cull, keep the cost. (view)

## Close
- Count your standing meetings first.
- Reply "meetings" and we will send how.

## Image briefs
1. Card, dark blue, large "56 / 5" in cream.
2. Card, one flat cream line across, headline above.
3. Bar chart, two amber bars 14 and 5, before / after.
4. Card, headline only, centred.
5. Card, the ask in brand type.

## Not written
- none
